t: This is the statue of Sir John Franklin, a Grade II listed figure beside the Athenaeum Club on Waterloo Place. It was made by Matthew Noble, a leading portrait sculptor of Victorian statesmen and royalty. Franklin was a Royal Navy officer and explorer who led two expeditions into the Canadian Arctic and later served as Lieutenant-Governor of Van Diemen's Land. In 1845 he set out to traverse the Northwest Passage. His ships became icebound off King William Island, and he died there in June 1847.
